method: Actual browser playback of the same final Game recordings, with temporal screenshot inspection across the complete 18-second clips. Half speed took at least 36 seconds. Furniture, feet and root position inspected; no frame interpolation.
viewport: Default browser viewport; user resized its panel during playback. Office half speed repeated with whole video visible; court and corridor reviewed separately at both rates.

observations.classroom: Desk, chair and body anchors remain fixed; small wrist and head movement. No whole-painting jump seen.
observations.office: Desks and monitors remain fixed; restrained writing/typing movement, no root teleport seen.
observations.court: NPC stays planted and ball changes height; independent gameplay pickup ball intentionally remains.
observations.corridor: Stable students and shoe locker; idle motion is subtle, no sudden position jump seen.

manual_judgment_pending: Campus visual atmosphere and room proportions
not_claimed: Visual approval of every one of the 13 NPCs in a dedicated moving closeup
